id.description: Unique identifier that identifies each instance of the job.

startTime.description: Step execution start time in UTC format.

endTime.description: Step execution end time in UTC format.

lastUpdated.description: Last updated time (in UTC format) post one of the step execution completion.

statusMessage.description: Displays status for overall steps that are part of the job.

createdTime.description: Job creation time in UTC format.

timeElapsed.description: Time lapsed since the job execution started.

stepExecutionStatuses.description: Status of each step within a job.
